answer: Ephemeral Ballot Seeding. Each round, a verifiable randomness beacon assigns every agent a fresh, unknowable slot in a gale of rotating work queues. An identity can only claim work if its slot is revealed after commit, so attackers cannot precompute which fabricated identities will be useful. To suppress spam, each slot claim requires an unpredictably timed micro-proof of work; a hollow identity farm must pay full compute per slot, since early or duplicated claims are rejected. Participation also earns a lotus credit that decays unless the agent accepts a random audit task.
